params.message:
The client product goes: companies, projects, pull-insights, chat sessions

The pipeline's client layer (about 1,380 lines: the routes for companies, projects,
project setup, company insights, pull-insights and chat sessions; pull-harvest.mjs;
clients-store.mjs; verifyClientInsights) served the client app that left with
gentells.com. Its last client insight is from 2026-04-08, projects and chat sessions
are empty, and the pull-harvest phase could not be scheduled: scoring read
state.companiesDue, which nothing set. The tables and their rows stay.

tenant-boundary.mjs goes with it; the rule it held (nothing a client brings enters
the shared graph) is the Gentells Standard's two-graph rule. The chat loses its
unused project context.

A new test resolves every relative import in the repo: removing clients-store left
fifteen imports in server.mjs pointing at nothing, and no test imports server.mjs.
The scan log keeps thirty days, pruned after every collect round.
